questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of establishing a visual hierarchy in a dashboard?

options.text: To guide user attention to key metrics
To reduce the number of charts

questions.explanation: Visual hierarchy directs user focus to the most important information first.

questions.prompt: Which of the following metrics is most appropriate to place at the top of a sales performance dashboard?
questions.explanation: The top metric should reflect the primary business goal, such as revenue.

questions.prompt: How does interactive filtering improve dashboard usability?

options.text: It allows users to customize views

questions.explanation: Interactive filters let users tailor the view to their needs.

questions.prompt: When designing a dashboard for executive stakeholders, which design principle should be prioritized?
questions.explanation: Executives need high-level insights, so a minimalist design reduces cognitive load.

questions.prompt: Which technique best supports drill-down navigation without cluttering the initial view?

options.text: Embedding all charts in a single page
Displaying all metrics in a table

questions.explanation: Breadcrumbs provide a clear path for drill-down while keeping the main view clean.

questions.prompt: Which color scheme is generally recommended for data dashboards?
questions.explanation: A muted palette reduces eye strain and accent colors highlight important data.
